title: Warehouse Lead
description:
Who We Are

At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.

Our Global Reach

JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

What We Offer

Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Location: Old Bridge, NJ

Pay rate: $23-$27

About the Role

The Warehouse Team Leader supports supervisors in managing daily warehouse operations while directly leading a small group of associates. This role is ideal for someone ready to step into leadership or grow their career in logistics. You’ll be responsible for ensuring smooth workflow, training new staff, and keeping performance on track.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead a small team of associates in one or more warehouse functions (receiving, picking, packing, etc.)

• Assist with labor planning and workflow coordination

• Train new team members on SOPs, safety, and process efficiency

• Monitor order accuracy, report issues, and escalate when needed

• Ensure a clean and safe working environment

Qualifications

• 1–2 years of warehouse experience; prior team lead or unofficial leadership experience preferred

• Strong organizational and communication skills

• Willingness to work overtime and support flexible scheduling

• Familiarity with scanners or WMS systems is a plus

• Mandarin skills required

Preferred Traits

• Eager to learn and grow into a supervisor role

• Dependable, positive, and team-oriented

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Network Planning: Responsible for network planning in the America region, mainly including warehouse network planning (warehouse network model, layout, site selection), hub planning (sorting layout, sorting site selection, sorting function positioning), transport capacity planning (transshipment dispatching mode, transportation route and schedule planning), and terminal planning (station planning, site selection, operation mode). Bachelor's degree or above, majors in Logistics, supply chain management, and other related fields.

•
More than 3 years of experience in America logistics network planning, process planning related work (America e-commerce, or large America third-party logistics companies).

•
Quickly grasp the development trends of the America logistics industry and the company's business trends, familiar with network resource layout and planning logic. Possess rigorous logical thinking and data sensitivity, good summarization and induction abilities, and data analysis capabilities. Proficient in at least one data analysis tool, such as EXCEL, SQL, Python, etc.

(1) Safety System Development: Build a Global Standardized Safety Framework

Uphold the philosophy of “prevention first, systematic governance”, and establish a safety management system for each overseas warehouse:

•
Organizational Structure & Execution Mechanisms: Set up dedicated security teams in each overseas warehouse. Through daily on-site security management, monthly safety meetings, high-frequency risk inspections, and an annual comprehensive assessment mechanism, collaborate with business units to develop hazard-rectification plans. •
Policy & Standard Development: Based on local laws and regulations, develop 36 security management policies across 12 major domains, including EHS, fire safety, electrical safety, special equipment management, and visitor control, promoting standardized and regulated overseas security management.

(2) Loss Control System: End-to-End Risk Management

Establish a shrinkage-prevention mechanism covering the full warehouse lifecycle:

•
Security & Dynamic Inventory Management:

•
Through standardized security team development, dual-review inbound/outbound processes, and the use of intelligent security-screening technologies, effectively prevent internal and external theft. Leverage dynamic inventory checks and reverse-logistics audit systems to achieve real-time monitoring and visualized management of product and fixed-asset loss.

•
Supply Chain Collaboration Optimization:

•
For key steps such as inbound receiving, outbound fulfillment, and disposal of obsolete materials, establish process-gap assessment and iteration mechanisms. Collaborate with suppliers and logistics partners to optimize operational standards, significantly reducing risks such as receiving discrepancies and fraudulent shipments.

(3) Audit & Compliance Oversight

Build a multi-dimensional risk-monitoring network:

•
End-to-End Penetrative Auditing: Conduct full-process audits of core business areas such as procurement, contracts, and construction. Through compliance reviews and cross-data comparison, accurately identify potential asset-loss risks, promoting business-process optimization and refined cost control.

•
Professional Case Investigation Mechanism: For internal/external theft, fraud, and other violations, conduct in-depth investigations jointly with integrity/ethics teams. Establish a closed-loop management system of “risk detection – special investigation – rectification implementation – accountability tracing”, effectively curbing non-compliance.

(4) Operational Assurance: Supporting Global Business Resilience

Provide comprehensive safety assurance for global operations:

•
Full-Lifecycle Protection of Personnel & Assets: Develop a personnel-safety system covering labor-compliance management, drug-prevention measures, and emergency response for violent incidents. Through dynamic asset inventory, warehouse-rental risk assessments, and intelligent inventory monitoring, achieve full-lifecycle management of assets from procurement to disposal.

•
Global Coordinated Emergency Response: Leverage local government, Chinese community, and police resources to build a rapid-response mechanism for emergencies. Establish a 24×365 global monitoring and alarm center to enable real-time monitoring of overseas warehouses and enterprise-police linkage, providing strong support for new warehouse setup, business integration, and major safety-incident handling.

International Security will continue integrating a global perspective with local practices, iterating and upgrading the safety management system to ensure strong support for the sustainable development of cross-border operations.

•

Job Description

Job Title: Transport Specialist – Carrier Management

Location: Bedford, UK
Department: Transportation / Supply Chain
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Language Requirement: Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese
Working Arrangement: On-site; flexibility to support operational shifts and peak periods may be required

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Transport Specialist to oversee carrier management and outbound transportation operations at our Bedford warehouse.

The role will coordinate both B2B and B2C outbound shipments, manage day-to-day communication and performance with parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile carriers, and lead a small transportation operations team.

The successful candidate will work closely with the warehouse outbound team to ensure an accurate and controlled handover of goods, timely carrier collections and effective resolution of operational exceptions. This position requires strong transportation knowledge, excellent stakeholder-management skills and the ability to communicate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Key Responsibilities

Transport Operations

• Oversee daily B2B and B2C outbound transportation activities from the Bedford warehouse.

• Plan and coordinate parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile collections according to order volume, service requirements and operational cut-off times.

• Allocate shipments to suitable carriers based on service type, capacity, cost, delivery requirements and operational performance.

• Ensure vehicles and carriers arrive as scheduled and that all shipments are dispatched within the required timeframes.

• Monitor shipment progress and proactively manage collection failures, delays, missed scans, delivery exceptions, damages, losses and returns.

• Support peak-period planning, contingency arrangements and urgent or ad-hoc transport requirements.

Carrier Management

• Act as the main operational contact between the Bedford warehouse and contracted carriers.

• Maintain effective daily communication with carrier account managers, depots, drivers and control teams.

• Conduct regular carrier performance reviews covering on-time collection, on-time delivery, scanning compliance, loss and damage, claims, customer complaints and service failures.

• Escalate recurring issues and drive carriers to provide root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.

• Support carrier onboarding, operational testing, service changes and the implementation of new transport solutions.

• Verify that carriers follow agreed SOPs, service requirements, safety standards and contractual obligations.

• Work with procurement and management teams to support carrier reviews, cost control and continuous improvement.

Warehouse Handover and Dispatch Control

• Work closely with the warehouse outbound team to align picking, packing, staging, loading and carrier collection schedules.

• Establish and maintain a clear handover process between warehouse and transportation teams.

• Confirm shipment quantities, pallet or parcel counts, labels, manifests and supporting documentation before goods are released.

• Ensure all physical handovers and system handovers are properly recorded and traceable.

• Investigate discrepancies between physical goods, system records and carrier collection data.

• Coordinate the safe and efficient loading of vehicles and ensure goods are handed over to the correct carrier.

• Conduct daily reviews of outstanding, uncollected or unsuccessfully dispatched shipments.

Team Leadership

• Lead and coordinate a small transport operations team responsible for dispatch planning, carrier communication and shipment monitoring.

• Allocate daily tasks and ensure appropriate operational coverage throughout the working day.

• Provide training, coaching and operational guidance to team members.

• Monitor team performance and ensure issues are escalated and resolved promptly.

• Maintain clear SOPs, shift handovers and escalation procedures.

• Promote strong collaboration between transportation, warehouse operations, customer service, procurement and other internal teams.

Compliance and Reporting

• Ensure transportation activities comply with company procedures and applicable UK transport, health and safety and security requirements.

• Support compliant handling and transportation of dangerous goods where applicable.

• Maintain accurate transport records, manifests, proof of collection, delivery evidence and exception records.

• Produce daily and weekly reports covering shipment volumes, carrier performance, operational exceptions and outstanding actions.

• Identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

• Support internal audits, carrier investigations and customer claims where required.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against areas including:

• On-time carrier collection

• On-time dispatch and delivery performance

• Successful warehouse-to-carrier handover

• Shipment scanning and tracking compliance

• Loss, damage and claims performance

• Transport exception closure time

• Carrier capacity fulfilment

• Customer complaint levels

• Transport cost and operational efficiency

• Team productivity and SOP compliance

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience in transportation, carrier management, dispatch or logistics operations.

• Practical experience managing B2B and B2C outbound shipments.

• Experience working directly with parcel carriers, pallet networks, freight providers or last-mile delivery companies.

• Previous experience leading, supervising or coordinating a small operational team.

• Strong understanding of warehouse dispatch, shipment handover and carrier collection processes.

• Ability to manage multiple carriers, priorities and operational exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.

• Confident user of transportation, warehouse or carrier-management systems.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.

• Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin Chinese.

• Eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working in an e-commerce, retail, fulfilment or third-party logistics environment.

• Experience managing high-volume parcel and last-mile operations.

• Knowledge of UK parcel, pallet and freight carrier networks.

• Experience handling dangerous goods or working in a dangerous-goods warehouse environment.

• Knowledge of ADR requirements and dangerous-goods transport documentation.

• Experience with transport management systems, warehouse management systems and carrier portals.

• Experience conducting carrier performance reviews and managing corrective action plans.

• Transport Manager CPC or another relevant logistics qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.

Personal Attributes

• Hands-on, organised and comfortable working in a warehouse environment.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Calm and decisive when managing operational pressure and service failures.

• Clear and confident communicator with both internal teams and external carriers.

• Able to challenge poor performance professionally and drive issues through to resolution.

• Detail-oriented, commercially aware and focused on continuous improvement.

• Capable of working effectively across Chinese and UK business cultures.

We are looking for a Quality Inspector to join our Reverse Logistics team, responsible for inspecting and assessing high-value returned consumer electronics, including mobile phones, graphics cards, gaming consoles and other electronic products.

• Previous experience in electronic product inspection, testing or repair, particularly with mobile phones, computers, graphics cards, gaming consoles or similar products.

• 2+ years of relevant experience is preferred.

• Good understanding of consumer electronics hardware, product functionality and basic fault diagnosis.

• Ability to identify signs of tampering, component replacement, product substitution, missing parts and other abnormalities.

• Experience in electronics repair, refurbishment, quality inspection or used-electronics assessment is highly desirable.

• Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.

title: Logistics Process Planning
description:
Who We Are

At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.

Our Global Reach

JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

What We Offer

Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Job Details

•
Job Title: Process Planning

•
Location: California or New Jersey

•
Annual Salary: $80,000 - $150,000 USD + Annual Performance Bonus

What You'll Do

•
Warehouse and Sorting Center Process Planning: Responsible for the process planning of warehouse and sorting center for America logistics business, including data analysis, process design, working route design, equipment selection, functional area layout, etc., output CAD layout plans and ROI analysis; continuously improves logistics operation efficiency through process optimizations and reduces operating costs.

•
Automation Planning and Implementation: Familiar with international automated logistics technology and scenarios, combining local operational characteristics in Europe, design the selection, layout, and system integration of automated equipment, promote the connection and implementation of automated equipment with various internal system links (such as WMS、WCS、TMS), ensuring the feasibility of the technical solution.

•
Pre-sales Planning: For pre-sales projects, participate in customer communication and needs research, interpret RFP documents, independently complete process planning and technical bid documents writing, providing professional and implementable warehousing planning and automation solutions for project bidding.

•
Planning for the Standardization System Construction: Sort out and improve the layout standards of process planning, equipment selection and configuration standards, process optimization execution rules, management standards, and cross-departmental collaboration mechanisms within the America warehouses, to promote the accumulation and replication of standardized capabilities.

About You

•
Bachelor's degree or above, majors in Industrial Engineering, Logistics and supply chain management, Automation, and other related fields.

•
More than 3 years of experience in process planning or automation planning. Familiar with the layout logic of warehousing/processing centers, operation process design and the characteristics of common logistics equipment. Those with experience in America or cross-border logistics planning are preferred.

•
Possess rigorous logical thinking and data sensitivity, capable of independently completing complex scheme data analysis and ROI calculation. Proficient in using CAD for warehouse layout drawing, and master at least one data analysis tool (such as Excel, SQL, Python).

•
Possess strong project coordination and cross-departmental communication skills, and be able to adapt to periodic business trips within the America region; be good at summarizing and extracting, and have the ability to quickly learn and consolidate methodologies.
